kind: C4 integrity record for the preregistered H37-3 far-field licence test (knowledge/34_preregistration_H37-3_licence.md).

same_seed_reproduction.why: The preregistered C4 asks that the added arm not perturb the base arms. The strongest available same-seed check is the spent-seed smoke panel: the patched harness (licence enabled) re-ran the identical 4 cells of seed 181 that the pre-patch harness ran, and the base arms are identical to the last bit.
same_seed_reproduction.panel: seed 181, 4 quadrant folds, thin_d 2.8, dilate 3 px, buffer 6 px

fresh_decade_base_arms_within_documented.note: The 260-264 base arms are NOT expected to equal the stored 210-214 diagnostic: the seeds differ. They are checked against the repository's documented LOSFO seed-to-seed spread of -12 %..+20 % (README instrument block; knowledge/29).
